item.title: '90 Day Fiance: The Other Way': Madelein has pregnancy scare, Manon drops a big secret, Jenny struggles
item.description: 90 Day Fiance: '90 Day Fiance: The Other Way': Madelein has pregnancy scare, Manon drops a big secret, Jenny struggles. 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way featured Madelein and Luke having a pregnancy scare and business dispute, Manon confessing a secret to Anthony, Jenny struggling to run the Indian cafe, and Matthew not giving up hope on Greta during the Season 7 episode that aired Monday night on TLC.

item.title: 'The Golden Bachelor' alum Peg Munson reveals when Mel Owens finally said "I love you"
item.description: The Bachelor: 'The Golden Bachelor' alum Peg Munson reveals when Mel Owens finally said "I love you". The Golden Bachelor alum Peg Munson has revealed when and how Mel Owens first expressed his love to her.

item.title: 'The Voice' crowns Aiden Ross its Season 28 winner, keeping coach Niall Horan undefeated
item.description: The Voice: 'The Voice' crowns Aiden Ross its Season 28 winner, keeping coach Niall Horan undefeated. The Voice crowned Aiden Ross the winner of Season 28, keeping his coach, Niall Horan, the only undefeated coach in show history during the episode that aired Tuesday night on NBC.

item.title: 'Survivor' Showmance Couples: Where are they now? Who's still together? (PHOTOS)
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor' Showmance Couples: Where are they now? Who's still together? (PHOTOS) . Survivor's 49th season has been airing on CBS this fall with a brand-new cast of new castaways-- but what about Survivor's former showmance couples? Which Survivor showmances are still together, and who broke up?

item.title: 'Survivor' crowns Savannah Louie Season 49 winner from an all-female Final 3
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor' crowns Savannah Louie Season 49 winner from an all-female Final 3. Survivor featured Savannah Louie being crowned the "Sole Survivor" and the winner of $1 million over Sophi "Soph" Balerdi during the Season 49 finale that aired Wednesday night on CBS.

item.title: 'Survivor' announces nationwide search for 50 hidden Immunity Idols ahead of Season 50
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor' announces nationwide search for 50 hidden Immunity Idols ahead of Season 50. Survivor fans across America have been invited to search for 50 hidden Immunity Idols across all 50 states in celebration of the CBS reality series' milestone 50th season.
